about: Fredericton is the capital of New Brunswick, on a bend of the Saint John River in the west of the province. It is a government and university city—home to the University of New Brunswick and St. Thomas University—with a compact downtown and a restored garrison district. Tree-lined streets and a riverside green distinguish it from the province’s larger port and retail centres. About 63,000 people live in Fredericton.
